answer_1.quote: The outputs of text generation systems are increasingly seen as human-like...
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to user inputs in conversational settings

answer_4.quote: we designed a crowdsourcing study to surface additional possible interventions. This study was IRB-approved, and consent was obtained from each participant before participation... Participants were then asked to highlight the words or phrases in the output text that seem human-like to them... rated how human-like the text appears to them on a five-point scale... identified why the text appears human-like to them by selecting from a multiple-choice list...
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated human-likeness on a five-point scale and selected reasons from predefined anthropomorphic behavior categories, then rewrote the text to be less human-like.
